GOV-F-004-S129.title: Audit Log Schema and Contract Definition
GOV-F-004-S129.description: Define the canonical audit log schema including fields for actor (GPT/Claude), operation type, input/output hashes, timestamps, trace_id, and previous_hash for chaining. Implement Pydantic models and enforce validation at write boundaries.

GOV-F-004-S130.title: Append-Only Write Service with Hash Chain Enforcement
GOV-F-004-S130.description: Implement core audit logging service that enforces append-only writes and constructs a cryptographic hash chain (previous_hash linkage). Reject updates/deletes and validate chain continuity on each write.
GOV-F-004-S130.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (logging baseline); Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (write patterns); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S131.title: Immutable Storage Strategy (Mongo Collection + Indexing)
GOV-F-004-S131.description: Create dedicated audit_log collection with write-once constraints enforced at application layer, including indexes on trace_id, timestamp, and actor. Ensure no update/delete operations are exposed and optimize for sequential writes and range queries.
GOV-F-004-S131.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (Mongo access patterns); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (read-only access precedent); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S132.title: Tamper Detection and Chain Verification Utility
GOV-F-004-S132.description: Implement utility to recompute and verify the full audit log hash chain or segments by trace_id/time window. Flag inconsistencies and return verification status for API consumption.
